items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And his brother, Sam, is dead now, too. He played clarinet.

ctx.x: He played over at, uh, uh, Lincoln Garden with us. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, he bought that 49th in, uh, in Michigan. That big, black villain. Well, Margaret, Margaret. That big corner. But he lost it. He passed, you know. Yes, he's dead.
And his brother, Sam, is dead now, too. He played clarinet. Yeah. Uh-huh.
Yeah. Jimmy Newman, is he, where, he's here.
